method: Trusted Playwright gestures on production HTML/scripts. Fixed API and text-only synthetic documents. No replaced save implementation. Lean timings include event handler through first microtask, then first/second RAF arrival; 350ms follow-up window. Profile is a separate instrumented CDP trace, excluded from percentiles. Second RAF is a presentation opportunity, not physical display latency.
